page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8y.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the arm64-based Alibaba YiTian710 processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 4 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, operating at a clock speed of 2.75 GHz. The processor is equipped with 64 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 64 MB of L3 cache. It is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate average performance across standard compute and memory tasks, though certain workloads reveal specific hardware limitations. The instance achieves middle-tier scores in stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests, alongside average performance in Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput. However, memory write bandwidth for large blocks is weak, and the Passmark CPU encryption test registers in the bottom 10%, likely due to the lack of advanced vector and matrix extensions. Large-block read-only memory bandwidth remains average at 63.39 GB/sec, while write performance drops to 25.44 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g8y.xlarge offers a resource-dense profile for arm64-native applications, delivering dedicated CPU resources without the overhead of multi-threading. It is well-suited for general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, database operations, and lightweight text or data processing. However, it is less suitable for cryptography-heavy applications, large language model inference, or tasks requiring high-speed local storage.
